summary: @ornikar/renovate-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Renovate shared configuration but ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (hex-named identifiers, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, opaque precomputed token tables, `@bun`/`@bun-cjs` header) with no functional relationship to a Renovate JSON config. The preinstall fires automatically on `npm install`, and the alternate-runtime invocation (Bun rather than Node) evades Node-only static analysis. Package contents and stated purpose do not match: a `renovate-config` package should contain only JSON configuration, not a runtime dropper plus an obfuscated executable payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
